hook: Waymo recalled 4,488 vehicles after 11 robotaxis entered closed freeway lanes.

sections.voiceover: Waymo recalled 4,488 vehicles after 11 robotaxis entered closed freeway lanes.
Do Waymo's 5th and 6th generation automated driving systems cause these 11 dangerous freeway incidents?
The software failed to recognize closed freeway lanes across California starting on October 1, 2026.

California's DMV banned driverless freeway operations after these 11 incidents, including three on November 9. Waymo LLC issued a voluntary recall for 4,488 vehicles following these 11 recorded safety incidents.
California officials now prohibit all driverless freeway operations due to these 11 recorded safety incidents.
